stories.title: Historic hearing begins as B.C. company wants to sell electricity exclusively to U.S.
stories.summary: For many years, the hydroelectric facilities provided power to a local pulp and paper mill and exported extra electricity to the United States.

stories.title: Man and woman fatally shot in Surrey double homicide
stories.summary: Police officers were called Sunday night to the Walmart parking lot at 88 Avenue and 124 Street, where a man and woman were found suffering from gunshot wounds that proved fatal.

stories.title: Canada’s Alert Ready emergency system will test notifications on Wednesday
stories.summary: The emergency alerts are used by governments to inform the public of emergencies including tornadoes, floods, wildfires and Amber Alerts

stories.title: Recipe: Spiced garlic ricotta and blueberry chutney
stories.summary: This ricotta spread is great on a cracker of your choice or on toast (with cucumber and tomato) or mixed in with rice or pasta! Its uses are endless.

stories.title: 4 charged following May homicide in Maple Ridge
stories.summary: The Integrated Homicide Investigation Team (IHIT) said Saturday that 25-year-old Charles Thomas Shields has been charged with one count of first-degree murder.

stories.title: Video circulating in Chilliwack reportedly shows assault of young girl, RCMP says
stories.summary: Officers said that on Nov. 8, they received a report of an alleged assault involving a group of youths and a female victim that happened that evening.

stories.title: Man receives conditional sentence in seawall tourist stranger attack
stories.summary: On Nov. 10, Peterhans Nungu, 35, pleaded guilty to assault causing bodily harm in the April 15, 2025 attack on a woman visiting from Toronto.

stories.title: ‘Half of my face has been destroyed’; Innocent bystander says shooting ruined his life
stories.summary: During a sentencing hearing in B.C. Supreme Court Thursday, the victim, anesthesiologist Dr. Neil Naya, described how being shot in the face by a stranger ruined his life.

stories.title: Canadian government investing $200M in B.C.’s Woodfibre LNG
stories.summary: The Woodfibre LNG facility, near Squamish, will receive natural gas, cool it into liquefied natural gas, where it will be loaded onto specialized LNG carriers and exported overseas

stories.title: 3 people dead, 5 rescued after boating incident in Squamish Valley
stories.summary: Squamish RCMP said that at approximately 1:52 p.m. they were called about a boat incident during elevated water levels and challenging weather conditions.
